label: Hockey

criteria.label: Arm and stick loading
criteria.look_for: stick loaded and released with the lower hand driving
criteria.drill: Stickhandle-and-shoot reps focusing on a clean load.

criteria.label: Posture
criteria.look_for: chest over the puck, stable shoulders
criteria.drill: Wall shots keeping the chest over the puck.

criteria.label: Low base
criteria.look_for: knees bent, weight through the front foot
criteria.drill: Squat-and-shoot: hold the low base through the follow-through.

criteria.label: Hip rotation
criteria.look_for: hips and shoulders rotating through the shot
criteria.drill: Rotational throws with a med ball.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge the shot: weight transfer, stick load, release, follow-through.
